s.en: set up and control zram devices

syn: Get info: ⏎ zramctl [options] ⏎ Reset zram: ⏎ zramctl -r zramdev... ⏎ Print name of first unused zram device: ⏎ zramctl -f

o.en: Set the compression algorithm to be used for compressing data in the zram device. The list of supported algorithms could be inaccurate as it depends on the current kernel configuration. A basic overview can be obtained by using the command "cat /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm";
Print sizes in bytes, not in human-readable format.
Find the first unused zram device. If a --size argument is present, then initialize the device.
Do not print a header line in status output.

Define the status output columns to be used. If no output arrangement is specified, then a default set is used. Use --help to get a list of all supported columns. The default list of columns may be extended if list is specified in the format +list (e.g., zramctl -o+COMP-RATIO).
Specify the parameters for the selected compression algorithm. For example, level=9 dict=/etc/dictionary sets the compression level and pre-trained dictionary. Parameters are algorithm-specific.
Reset the specified zram device(s). The settings of a zram device can be changed only after a reset.
Use the raw format for status output.

Create a zram device of the specified size. Zram devices are aligned to memory pages; when the requested size is not a multiple of the page size, it will be rounded up to the next multiple. When not otherwise specified, the unit of the size parameter is bytes.
Set the maximum number of compression streams that can be used for the device. The default is use all CPUs and one stream for kernels older than 4.6.
